stable.note: Main remains the clean foundation. The simulation exists only as a Lab candidate until independent CI and live deployment tests support promotion.

claims: deterministic seeded initialization on the same JavaScript numerical path

active_objective: Get independent GitHub Actions evidence for the first actual simulation vertical slice, then promote only if it passes and can be exercised from the live GitHub.io deployment.
next_gate: Open a pull request, observe the real CI run and logs, then merge only on PASS. After merge, test the public /sim/ page and separately test real iPhone Safari before calling the vertical slice device-verified.
